lead_headline: Two betas ship against a tide of bug reports as AI SDK and Workflow SDK lead a busy Tuesday
lead_body: Workflow SDK cut beta.6 with a graphile-worker schema bootstrap and a socket fix, while a new issue immediately flags Cloudflare Workers as blocked on node:vm. Claude Code pushed two releases but absorbed more issues than it closed — stale daemons, a context-spec regression, and a broken worktree attach path among them. AI SDK logged the highest commit count at 34, adding Gemini 3.5 Flash, a Cerebras provider, and managed-agents support.
lead_article:
A busy Tuesday across nearly every active project, with the headline movement split between two betas and a flood of bug reports. Workflow SDK cut workflow@5.0.0-beta.6 late in the evening, anchored by the graphile-worker schema bootstrap landing in the world-postgres setup CLI and a socket file location fix that went in twice — once to main, once backported. The release coincided with a new issue flagging that Cloudflare Workers support is blocked entirely by a node:vm dependency, a constraint worth watching as that runtime target grows in relevance. Claude Code pushed two releases — v2.1.144 and v2.1.145 — while accumulating a stack of bug reports: stale background daemons causing ENOENT on agent launch after upgrade, a context-spec regression in resumed sessions falling back to 200k, the EnterWorktree attach path broken again, and a Read tool failure on local images. The velocity of issues outpaced the releases today.

AI SDK was the highest-commit project at 34, with the substantive additions being Gemini 3.5 Flash, managed-agents support in Google's Interactions API, a Cerebras chat language model provider, and a streaming tool-call args fix for Google. Stream-resuming work is still in progress on a branch. Astro's day centered on exposing route asset URLs on middleware context — both a mainline PR and a v5 backport opened within hours of each other — alongside two HMR cache-invalidation fixes and a Solid rendering fix. Hydrogen opened a PR for generic cart type support, adding cart fragment override type generics to the implementation started yesterday. Gemma.cpp added Gemma 3 LM-only model variants and fixed a flash-attention test link error on multi-target SIMD builds. Metaflow's single PR prevents duplicate DAGTask names in foreach plus split-switch flows — quiet, but the kind of correctness fix that matters when pipelines branch.
